items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Tweed Beard brought me to Detroit and I worked at Tom's Cabin with him

ctx.x: details about the period of time when you entered the "big time" with Kelly Martin and what you were doing just before that and how that job came about.

Well, what had happened, my father--like I said before--we went to Detroit to visit and we saw Andy Kirk and I first heard Charlie Parker and Jimmy Forrest. But my father, unbeknownst to me, he knew about the Club Congo and I think they were rehearsing that day and we went by there and he got Kelly Martin to the side... and Kelly Martin didn't tell me this till years later. He says, "My son is good, please hire my son, if you want him to play tenor or baritone, I'll get him a baritone." And I didn't know that…
side and said, "Please hire my son." He told me that years later. I say, "Well, I'll be dawgone;" he says, "Yeah, your father told me." Hahahaha.
